sources.title: 国土数値情報（鉄道データ）2025年度版 N02-25
sources.attribution: Source: MLIT National Land Numerical Information (Railway) N02-25, 2025 dataset, https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/datalist/KsjTmplt-N02-2025.html, retrieved 2026-11-06. Extracted Kyoto–Toji route-link and station-line features; route geometry vertex order reversed and local cumulative chainage calculated by Cue.
sources.usageNotes: Credit the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism and the dataset page; state that the route/station subset was extracted and the route order/chainage processed. Do not imply that MLIT certifies this derivative simulator geometry.
sources.reliabilityNotes: The dataset contains line geometry for railway routes and stations. Metadata equivalent scale: 1:25,000; coordinate QA compares values with the referenced source and reports 0% mismatch, not a metre-level absolute survey error. It does not describe individual tracks, curve radius, cant, gradient, speed limits, signals, blocks, platform dimensions, or stop markers. N02-25 metadata dateStamp is 2026-03-06; the dataset reference date is 2025-12-31.

name.value: 近鉄京都線 京都—東寺
name.note: N02-25 route feature identifies route name 京都線 and operator 近畿日本鉄道; the two selected station features are 京都 and 東寺.

route.description: One station-to-station route-link geometry segment extracted from MLIT N02-25. This is a route-reference line, not a physical track-level or operations-complete simulator route.

totalLengthM.note: Local chainage is calculated by cumulative GRS80 inverse geodesic between the published N02-25 route-line vertices and rounded to 0.1 m. Status ESTIMATED reflects that the input is generalized route geometry, not a surveyed physical track or operator chainage; physical position error is not quantified by the source.

networkLengthM.note: An N02 route-link line is not an inventory of individual tracks; physical network length is not established.

officialCommercialDistanceM.note: Not included in this CC BY route-data payload; fare distance is a separate operator measure and is documented separately in QUALITY_REPORT.md.

name.note: Compatibility container for the N02 route-link geometry; no individual physical track identity is established.

direction.note: Operational up/down direction and individual track direction are not established. Package chainage orientation is documented separately as Kyoto to Toji.

gaugeMM.note: Track gauge is not asserted by the selected N02 route-link feature.

centerSpacingMM.note: Track count and track-center spacing are not asserted by N02 route geometry.

startChainageM.note: Start of the extracted route-link geometry at the Kyoto-side station-line boundary.

endChainageM.note: End of the extracted route-link geometry at the Toji-side station-line boundary.

alignment.note: N02 provides a route line, not a surveyed tangent/circular/transition-curve classification.

curveRadiusM.note: No curve radius is supplied by the source. Do not infer it from this generalized line geometry.

transitionLengthM.note: No transition-curve length is supplied by the source.

cantMM.note: Cant is not supplied by the source.

cantTransitionLengthM.note: Cant run-off length is not supplied by the source.

gradientPermille.note: Rail elevation profile and gradient are not supplied by the source.

speedLimitKmh.note: Authorized speed limits and restriction extents are not supplied by the source.

trackStructure.note: Ballast/slab/other track structure is not supplied by the source.

railProfile.note: Rail section/profile is not supplied by the source.

sleeperType.note: Sleeper type is not supplied by the source.

longWeldedRail.note: Long-welded-rail status is not supplied by the source.

segments.notes: Compatibility container only: the N02 feature represents railway route geometry, not an individual track segment. Not safe as-is for rail rendering or physics.

name.note: Station name and operator are recorded in the MLIT N02-25 Station feature.

chainageM.note: Station-center chainage is not supplied; see org.cue.railway.segmentBoundaryChainageM for the route-link boundary only.

stopPositionChainageM.note: Train stop marker/position is not supplied.

location.note: The source station feature is a LineString, not a station-centre point; preserve its exact line in route_geometry.geojson instead of inventing a centroid.

trackLayoutNotes.note: The N02 station line does not establish platform count, track layout, platform dimensions, or equipment.

org.cue.railway.referenceGeometry.representation: N02 railway route-link line; not a surveyed individual track centerline
org.cue.railway.referenceGeometry.coordinateReferenceSystem: JGD2011 / (B,L), source geometry is longitude-latitude pairs; no datum transformation performed
org.cue.railway.referenceGeometry.chainageMethod: Cumulative inverse geodesic on GRS80; output rounded to 0.1 m

kyoto.note: N02 railway-section line begins at the Kyoto-station-line endpoint; this is not the train stopping position or station center.

toji.note: N02 railway-section line ends at the Toji-station-line endpoint; this is not the train stopping position or station center.
